fix: Load the JWT signing secret from an environment variable or secret manager, rotate the exposed one, and remove it from source.
Use a parameterized query such as `title LIKE $1` with the value `%${q}%` passed in the params array.
Resolve the path, verify it stays inside REPORT_DIR (or use path.basename / sendFile with the root option), and reject anything else.
Hash passwords with a salted adaptive algorithm such as bcrypt, scrypt or argon2 instead of MD5.
Validate the URL against an allowlist of schemes and hosts and block private, loopback and link-local addresses before fetching.
Require requireAdmin or check ticket ownership (e.g. AND owner_id = $2) before deleting.
Validate format against a fixed allowlist and use execFile with an argument array instead of exec with string interpolation.
